segments.mnd16:3.2: Ito pubbe me mayā na diṭṭhapubbo so bhagavā iminā cakkhunā iminā attabhāvena.
segments.mnd16:3.3: Yadā bhagavā tāvatiṃsabhavane pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ vassaṃvuttho [vassaṃvuṭṭho (syā.)] devagaṇaparivuto majjhe maṇimayena sopāṇena saṅkassanagaraṃ otiṇṇo imaṃ dassanaṃ pubbe na diṭṭhoti –
segments.mnd16:4.2: Iccāti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ –
segments.mnd16:4.6: Sāriputtoti tassa therassa nāmaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpoti –
segments.mnd16:5.3: Udāti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ –
segments.mnd16:5.5: Kassacīti khattiyassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā vessassa vā suddassa vā gahaṭṭhassa vā pabbajitassa vā devassa vā manussassa vāti –
segments.mnd16:6.2: Evaṃ vagguvado madhuravado pemanīyavado hadayaṅgamavado karavīkarutamañjughoso [karavikarudamañjussaro (syā.)].
segments.mnd16:6.3: Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato kho pana tassa bhagavato mukhato ghoso niccharati –
segments.mnd16:6.4: visaṭṭho ca viññeyyo ca mañju ca savanīyo ca bindu ca avisārī ca gambhīro ca ninnādi ca.
segments.mnd16:6.5: Yathā parisaṃ kho pana so bhagavā sarena viññāpeti, na assa bahiddhā parisāya ghoso niccharati, brahmassaro kho pana so bhagavā karavīkabhāṇīti –
segments.mnd16:7.2: Yathā satthavāho satte kantāraṃ tāreti, corakantāraṃ tāreti, vāḷakantāraṃ tāreti, dubbhikkhakantāraṃ tāreti, nirudakakantāraṃ tāreti uttāreti nittāreti patāreti khemantabhūmiṃ sampāpeti;
segments.mnd16:7.3: evameva bhagavā satthavāho satte kantāraṃ tāreti, jātikantāraṃ tāreti, jarākantāraṃ tāreti, byādhikantāraṃ … pe … maraṇakantāraṃ … sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsakantāraṃ tāreti rāgakantāraṃ tāreti dosakantāraṃ … mohakantāraṃ … mānakantāraṃ … diṭṭhikantāraṃ … kilesakantāraṃ … duccaritakantāraṃ tāreti, rāgagahanaṃ tāreti, dosagahanaṃ … mohagahanaṃ … mānagahanaṃ … diṭṭhigahanaṃ … kilesagahanaṃ … duccaritagahanaṃ tāreti uttāreti nittāreti patāreti khemantaṃ amataṃ nibbānaṃ sampāpetīti.
segments.mnd16:8.1: Atha vā bhagavā netā vinetā anunetā paññapetā nijjhāpetā pekkhetā pasādetāti.
segments.mnd16:9.1: Atha vā bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatāti.
segments.mnd16:10.2: Bhagavā tusitakāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkantoti.
segments.mnd16:11.2: Te tuṭṭhā santuṭṭhā attamanā pamuditā pītisomanassajātā devalokato gaṇiṃ āgatoti.
segments.mnd16:11.5: Te tuṭṭhā santuṭṭhā attamanā paripuṇṇasaṅkappā arahantānaṃ gaṇiṃ āgatoti.
segments.mnd16:11.8: Gaṇācariyoti gaṇī, gaṇassa satthāti gaṇī, gaṇaṃ pariharatīti gaṇī, gaṇaṃ ovadatīti gaṇī, gaṇamanusāsatīti gaṇī, visārado gaṇaṃ upasaṅkamatīti gaṇī, gaṇassa [gaṇossa (sī.)] sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapetīti gaṇī, gaṇaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetīti gaṇī, bhikkhugaṇassa gaṇī, bhikkhunigaṇassa gaṇī, upāsakagaṇassa gaṇī, upāsikāgaṇassa gaṇī, rājagaṇassa gaṇī, khattiyagaṇassa … brāhmaṇagaṇassa … vessagaṇassa … suddagaṇassa … devagaṇassa … brahmagaṇassa gaṇī, saṅghī gaṇī gaṇācariyo.
segments.mnd16:15.1: Sadevakassa lokassāti sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāyāti –
segments.mnd16:16.1: Yathā dissati cakkhumāti yathā bhagavantaṃ tāvatiṃsabhavane pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ nisinnaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ devatā passanti tathā manussā passanti.
segments.mnd16:16.2: Yathā manussā passanti tathā devatā passanti.
segments.mnd16:16.3: Yathā devānaṃ dissati tathā manussānaṃ dissati.
segments.mnd16:16.4: Yathā manussānaṃ dissati tathā devānaṃ dissatīti.
segments.mnd16:16.6: Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā adantā dantavaṇṇena dissanti, asantā santavaṇṇena dissanti, anupasantā upasantavaṇṇena dissanti, anibbutā nibbutavaṇṇena dissanti.
segments.mnd16:17.4: anto asuddhā bahi sobhamānā”ti [ayaṃ gāthā saṃ. ni.1.122 dissati].
segments.mnd16:18.2: Bhagavā bhūtena tacchena tathena yāthāvena aviparītena sabhāvena danto dantavaṇṇena dissati, santo santavaṇṇena dissati, upasanto upasantavaṇṇena dissati, nibbuto nibbutavaṇṇena dissati, akappitairiyāpathā ca buddhā bhagavanto paṇidhisampannāti.
segments.mnd16:19.1: Atha vā bhagavā visuddhasaddo gatakittisaddasiloko [bhaṭakittisaddasiloko (syā.)] nāgabhavane ca supaṇṇabhavane ca yakkhabhavane ca asurabhavane ca gandhabbabhavane ca mahārājabhavane ca indabhavane ca brahmabhavane ca devabhavane ca ediso ca tādiso ca tato ca bhiyyoti.
segments.mnd16:20.1: Atha vā bhagavā dasahi balehi samannāgato, catūhi vesārajjehi, catūhi paṭisambhidāhi, chahi abhiññāhi, chahi buddhadhammehi, tejena ca balena ca guṇena ca vīriyena ca paññāya ca dissati ñāyati paññāyati.
segments.mnd16:21.4: rattiṃ khittā [rattikhittā (sī.) dha. pa.304] yathā sarā”ti.
segments.mnd16:23.2: maṃsacakkhunāpi cakkhumā, dibbacakkhunāpi cakkhumā, paññācakkhunāpi cakkhumā, buddhacakkhunāpi cakkhumā, samantacakkhunāpi cakkhumā.
segments.mnd16:24.3: nīlo ca vaṇṇo, pītako ca vaṇṇo, lohitako ca vaṇṇo, kaṇho ca vaṇṇo, odāto ca vaṇṇo.
segments.mnd16:24.5: Yattha ca akkhilomāni patiṭṭhitāni taṃ nīlaṃ hoti sunīlaṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ umāpupphasamānaṃ.
segments.mnd16:24.6: Tassa parato pītakaṃ hoti supītakaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ kaṇikārapupphasamānaṃ.
segments.mnd16:24.7: Ubhato akkhikūṭāni bhagavato lohitakāni honti sulohitakāni pāsādikāni dassaneyyāni indagopakasamānāni.
segments.mnd16:24.8: Majjhe kaṇhaṃ hoti sukaṇhaṃ alūkhaṃ suddhaṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ addāriṭṭhakasamānaṃ.
segments.mnd16:24.9: Tassa parato odātaṃ hoti suodātaṃ setaṃ paṇḍaraṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ osadhitārakasamānaṃ.
segments.mnd16:24.10: Tena bhagavā pākatikena maṃsacakkhunā attabhāvapariyāpannena purimasucaritakammābhinibbattena samantā yojanaṃ passati divā ceva rattiñca.
segments.mnd16:24.11: Yadāpi caturaṅgasamannāgato andhakāro hoti sūriyo ca atthaṅgato hoti;
segments.mnd16:24.12: kāḷapakkho ca uposatho hoti, tibbo ca vanasaṇḍo hoti, mahā ca kāḷamegho abbhuṭṭhito hoti.
segments.mnd16:24.13: Evarūpepi caturaṅgasamannāgate andhakāre samantā yojanaṃ passati.
segments.mnd16:24.14: Natthi so kuṭṭo vā kavāṭaṃ vā pākāro vā pabbato vā gaccho vā latā vā āvaraṇaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya.
segments.mnd16:24.15: Ekañce tilaphalaṃ nimittaṃ katvā tilavāhe pakkhipeyya, taññeva tilaphalaṃ uddhareyya.
segments.mnd16:25.2: Bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate;
segments.mnd16:25.4: “ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā;
segments.mnd16:25.5: ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā”ti.
segments.mnd16:25.6: Iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate;
segments.mnd16:25.8: Ākaṅkhamāno ca bhagavā ekampi lokadhātuṃ passeyya, dvepi lokadhātuyo passeyya, tissopi lokadhātuyo passeyya, catassopi lokadhātuyo passeyya, pañcapi lokadhātuyo passeyya, dasapi lokadhātuyo passeyya, vīsampi [vīsatimpi (sī.)] lokadhātuyo passeyya, tiṃsampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, cattālīsampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, paññāsampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, satampi lokadhātuṃ passeyya, sahassimpi cūḷanikaṃ lokadhātuṃ passeyya, dvisahassimpi majjhimikaṃ lokadhātuṃ passeyya, tisahassimpi lokadhātuṃ passeyya, mahāsahassimpi lokadhātuṃ passeyya, yāvatakaṃ pana ākaṅkheyya tāvatakaṃ passeyya.
segments.mnd16:26.2: Bhagavā mahāpañño puthupañño hāsapañño javanapañño tikkhapañño nibbedhikapañño paññāpabhedakusalo pabhinnañāṇo adhigatapaṭisambhido catuvesārajjappatto dasabaladhārī purisāsabho purisasīho purisanāgo purisājañño purisadhorayho anantañāṇo anantatejo anantayaso aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavā netā vinetā anunetā paññapetā nijjhāpetā pekkhetā pasādetā.
segments.mnd16:26.3: So hi bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā.
segments.mnd16:27.1: So hi bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato.
segments.mnd16:27.2: Natthi tassa bhagavato aññātaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya.
segments.mnd16:27.3: Atītaṃ anāgataṃ paccuppannaṃ upādāya sabbe dhammā sabbākārena buddhassa bhagavato ñāṇamukhe āpāthaṃ āgacchanti.
segments.mnd16:27.4: Yaṃ kiñci neyyaṃ nāma atthi jānitabbaṃ [atthi dhammaṃ jānitabbaṃ (ka.) mahāni.156] attattho vā, parattho vā, ubhayattho vā, diṭṭhadhammiko vā attho, samparāyiko vā attho, uttāno vā attho, gambhīro vā attho, gūḷho vā attho, paṭicchanno vā attho, neyyo vā attho, nīto vā attho, anavajjo vā attho, nikkileso vā attho, vodāno vā attho, paramattho vā attho, sabbaṃ taṃ antobuddhañāṇe parivattati.
segments.mnd16:28.1: Atīte buddhassa bhagavato appaṭihataṃ ñāṇaṃ, anāgate appaṭihataṃ ñāṇaṃ, paccuppanne appaṭihataṃ ñāṇaṃ.
segments.mnd16:28.5: Yāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ tāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ, yāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ tāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ;
segments.mnd16:28.7: neyyaṃ atikkamitvā ñāṇaṃ nappavattati, ñāṇaṃ atikkamitvā neyyapatho natthi;
segments.mnd16:28.9: Yathā dvinnaṃ samuggapaṭalānaṃ sammāphusitānaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ samuggapaṭalaṃ uparimaṃ nātivattati, uparimaṃ samuggapaṭalaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ nātivattati, aññamaññapariyantaṭṭhāyino;
segments.mnd16:28.10: evamevaṃ buddhassa bhagavato neyyañca ñāṇañca aññamaññapariyantaṭṭhāyino.
segments.mnd16:28.11: Yāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ tāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ, yāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ tāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ, neyyapariyantikaṃ ñāṇaṃ, ñāṇapariyantikaṃ neyyaṃ;
segments.mnd16:28.12: neyyaṃ atikkamitvā ñāṇaṃ na pavattati, ñāṇaṃ atikkamitvā neyyapatho natthi;
segments.mnd16:29.2: Sabbe dhammā buddhassa bhagavato āvajjanapaṭibaddhā ākaṅkhapaṭibaddhā manasikārapaṭibaddhā cittuppādapaṭibaddhā.
segments.mnd16:29.4: Sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ bhagavā āsayaṃ jānāti, anusayaṃ jānāti, caritaṃ jānāti, adhimuttiṃ jānāti, apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye bhabbābhabbe satte pajānāti.
segments.mnd16:29.5: Sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā antobuddhañāṇe parivattati.
segments.mnd16:30.1: Yathā ye keci macchakacchapā antamaso timitimiṅgalaṃ upādāya antomahāsamudde parivattanti;
segments.mnd16:30.2: evameva sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā antobuddhañāṇe parivattati.
segments.mnd16:30.3: Yathā ye keci pakkhī antamaso garuḷaṃ venateyyaṃ upādāya ākāsassa padese parivattanti;
segments.mnd16:30.4: evameva yepi te sāriputtasamā paññāya tepi buddhañāṇassa padese parivattanti;
segments.mnd16:30.5: buddhañāṇaṃ devamanussānaṃ paññaṃ pharitvā abhibhavitvā tiṭṭhati.
segments.mnd16:30.6: Yepi te khattiyapaṇḍitā brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā gahapatipaṇḍitā samaṇapaṇḍitā nipuṇā kataparappavādā vālavedhirūpā vobhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni, te pañhe abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti gūḷhāni ca paṭicchannāni ca.
segments.mnd16:30.7: Kathitā visajjitāva te pañhā bhagavatā honti niddiṭṭhakāraṇā upakkhittakā ca.
segments.mnd16:30.9: Atha kho bhagavāva tattha atirocati, yadidaṃ paññāyāti.
segments.mnd16:31.2: Bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento [olokento (sī.)] addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante appekacce naparalokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
segments.mnd16:31.3: Seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakaṃ accuggamma tiṭṭhanti anupalittāni udakena;
segments.mnd16:31.4: evamevaṃ bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante appekacce naparalokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
segments.mnd16:31.6: “ayaṃ puggalo rāgacarito, ayaṃ dosacarito, ayaṃ mohacarito, ayaṃ vitakkacarito, ayaṃ saddhācarito, ayaṃ ñāṇacarito”ti.
segments.mnd16:31.9: mohacaritassa bhagavā puggalassa uddese paripucchāya kālena dhammassavane kālena dhammasākacchāya garusaṃvāse niveseti;
segments.mnd16:31.11: saddhācaritassa bhagavā puggalassa pasādanīyaṃ nimittaṃ ācikkhati buddhasubodhiṃ dhammasudhammataṃ saṅghasuppaṭipattiṃ sīlāni ca attano;
segments.mnd16:31.12: ñāṇacaritassa bhagavā puggalassa vipassanānimittaṃ ācikkhati aniccākāraṃ dukkhākāraṃ anattākāraṃ.
segments.mnd16:34.3: Bhagavā sabbaññutañāṇena upeto samupeto upagato samupagato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato.
segments.mnd16:37.1: Sabbaṃ tamaṃ vinodetvāti sabbaṃ rāgatamaṃ dosatamaṃ mohatamaṃ mānatamaṃ diṭṭhitamaṃ kilesatamaṃ duccaritatamaṃ andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhikaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ nuditvā panuditvā jahitvā pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvāti –
segments.mnd16:38.2: Ekoti bhagavā pabbajjāsaṅkhātena eko, adutiyaṭṭhena eko, taṇhāya pahānaṭṭhena eko, ekantavītarāgoti eko, ekantavītadosoti eko, ekantavītamohoti eko, ekantanikkilesoti eko, ekāyanamaggaṃ gatoti eko, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti eko.
segments.mnd16:39.2: Bhagavā daharova samāno susu kāḷakeso bhadrena [bhaddena (syā.)] yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ vilapantānaṃ ñātisaṅghaṃ pahāya sabbaṃ gharāvāsapalibodhaṃ chinditvā puttadārapalibodhaṃ chinditvā ñātipalibodhaṃ chinditvā mittāmaccapalibodhaṃ chinditvā sannidhipalibodhaṃ chinditvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā akiñcanabhāvaṃ upagantvā eko carati viharati iriyati vattati pāleti yapeti yāpeti –
segments.mnd16:40.2: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno eko araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni.
segments.mnd16:40.3: So eko carati, eko gacchati, eko tiṭṭhati, eko nisīdati, eko seyyaṃ kappeti, eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati, eko paṭikkamati, eko raho nisīdati, eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, eko carati viharati iriyati vattati pāleti yapeti yāpeti –
segments.mnd16:41.2: So evaṃ eko adutiyo appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto najjā nerañjarāya tīre bodhirukkhamūle mahāpadhānaṃ padahanto māraṃ sasenaṃ kaṇhaṃ namuciṃ pamattabandhuṃ vidhamitvā taṇhājāliniṃ visaritaṃ visattikaṃ pajahasi vinodesi byantiṃ akāsi anabhāvaṃ gamesi.
segments.mnd16:45.2: Rāgassa pahīnattā ekantavītarāgoti eko, dosassa pahīnattā ekantavītadosoti eko, mohassa pahīnattā ekantavītamohoti eko, kilesānaṃ pahīnattā ekantanikkilesoti eko.
segments.mnd16:46.2: Ekāyanamaggo vuccati cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
segments.mnd16:49.1: Kathaṃ bhagavā eko anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti eko?
segments.mnd16:49.2: Bodhi vuccati catūsu maggesu ñāṇaṃ paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīmaṃsā vipassanā sammādiṭṭhi.
segments.mnd16:49.3: Bhagavā tena bodhiñāṇena “sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti bujjhi,
segments.mnd16:49.20: channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca bujjhi,
segments.mnd16:49.21: pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca bujjhi,
segments.mnd16:49.22: catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca bujjhi,
segments.mnd16:50.1: Atha vā yaṃ kiñci bujjhitabbaṃ anubujjhitabbaṃ paṭibujjhitabbaṃ sambujjhitabbaṃ adhigantabbaṃ phassitabbaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ tena bodhiñāṇena bujjhi anubujjhi paṭibujjhi sambujjhi sammābujjhi adhigacchi phassesi sacchākāsi.
segments.mnd16:50.2: Evaṃ bhagavā eko anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti eko.
segments.mnd16:51.2: Ratinti nekkhammaratiṃ vivekaratiṃ upasamaratiṃ sambodhiratiṃ ajjhagā samajjhagā adhigacchi phassesi sacchākāsīti –
segments.mnd16:55.2: Buddhoti yo so bhagavā sayambhū anācariyako pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhi, tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇi [patto (syā.)], balesu ca vasībhāvaṃ pāpuṇi.
segments.mnd16:55.19: Buddhoti netaṃ mātarā kataṃ na pitarā kataṃ,
segments.mnd16:55.26: Vimokkhantikametaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutañāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti, yadidaṃ buddhoti –
segments.mnd16:55.31: Yāva taṇhāsaṅkhātena sīmakataṃ odhikataṃ [pariyādikataṃ (syā.)] pariyantakataṃ pariggahitaṃ mamāyitaṃ –
segments.mnd16:55.32: idaṃ mama, etaṃ mama, ettakaṃ mama, ettāvatā mama, mama rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā, attharaṇā pāvuraṇā dāsidāsā ajeḷakā kukkuṭasūkarā hatthigavāssavaḷavā, khettaṃ vatthuṃ hiraññaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ, gāmanigamarājadhāniyo raṭṭhañca janapado ca koso ca koṭṭhāgārañca, kevalampi mahāpathaviṃ taṇhāvasena mamāyati, yāvatā aṭṭhasataṃ taṇhāvicaritaṃ –
segments.mnd16:56.2: Vīsativatthukā sakkāyadiṭṭhi, dasavatthukā micchādiṭṭhi, dasavatthukā antaggāhikā diṭṭhi.
segments.mnd16:56.3: Yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyāsaggāho viparītaggāho vipallāsaggāho micchāgāho “ayāthāvakasmiṃ yāthāvakan”ti gāho yāvatā dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni –
segments.mnd16:57.1: Buddhassa bhagavato taṇhānissayo pahīno, diṭṭhinissayo paṭinissaṭṭho;
segments.mnd16:57.2: taṇhānissayassa pahīnattā diṭṭhinissayassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā bhagavā cakkhuṃ asito, sotaṃ … ghānaṃ … jivhaṃ … kāyaṃ … manaṃ asito,
segments.mnd16:57.4: kulaṃ … gaṇaṃ … āvāsaṃ … lābhaṃ … yasaṃ … pasaṃsaṃ … sukhaṃ … cīvaraṃ … piṇḍapātaṃ … senāsanaṃ … gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ …
segments.mnd16:57.5: kāmadhātuṃ … rūpadhātuṃ … arūpadhātuṃ … kāmabhavaṃ … rūpabhavaṃ … arūpabhavaṃ … saññābhavaṃ … asaññābhavaṃ … nevasaññānāsaññābhavaṃ …
segments.mnd16:57.8: diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbe dhamme asito anissito anallīno anupagato anajjhosito anadhimutto nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti –
segments.mnd16:58.2: iṭṭhāniṭṭhe tādī, cattāvīti tādī, tiṇṇāvīti tādī, muttāvīti tādī, taṃniddesā tādī.
segments.mnd16:59.2: Bhagavā lābhepi tādī, alābhepi tādī, yasepi tādī, ayasepi tādī, pasaṃsāyapi tādī nindāyapi tādī, sukhepi tādī, dukkhepi tādī;
segments.mnd16:59.3: ekacce bāhaṃ gandhena limpeyyuṃ, ekacce bāhaṃ vāsiyā taccheyyuṃ, amukasmiṃ natthi rāgo, amukasmiṃ natthi paṭighaṃ, anunayapaṭighavippahīno ugghātinigghātivītivatto anurodhavirodhaṃ samatikkanto.
segments.mnd16:60.2: Bhagavatā [bhagavato (syā.)] rāgo catto vanto mutto pahīno paṭinissaṭṭho, doso … pe … moho … kodho … upanāho … makkho … paḷāso … issā … macchariyaṃ … māyā … sāṭheyyaṃ … thambho … sārambho … māno … atimāno … mado … pamādo … sabbe kilesā … sabbe duccaritā … sabbe darathā … sabbe pariḷāhā … sabbe santāpā … sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārā cattā vantā muttā pahīnā paṭinissaṭṭhā.
segments.mnd16:61.2: Bhagavā kāmoghaṃ tiṇṇo, bhavoghaṃ tiṇṇo, diṭṭhoghaṃ tiṇṇo, avijjoghaṃ tiṇṇo, sabbaṃ saṃsārapathaṃ tiṇṇo uttiṇṇo nittiṇṇo atikkanto samatikkanto vītivatto.
segments.mnd16:61.3: So vuṭṭhavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo gataddho gatadiso gatakoṭiyo pālitabrahmacariyo uttamadiṭṭhippatto bhāvitamaggo pahīnakileso paṭividdhākuppo sacchikatanirodho.
segments.mnd16:61.4: Dukkhaṃ tassa pariññātaṃ, samudayo pahīno, maggo bhāvito, nirodho sacchikato, abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, pariññeyyaṃ pariññātaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvitaṃ, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikataṃ.
segments.mnd16:61.5: So ukkhittapaḷigho [ukkhittapaligho (syā. ka.) mahāni.6] saṃkiṇṇaparikkho abbūḷhesiko niraggaḷo ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaññutto pañcaṅgavippahīno chaḷaṅgasamannāgato ekārakkho caturāpasseno panuṇṇapaccekasacco samavayasaṭṭhesano anāvilasaṅkappo passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro suvimuttacitto suvimuttapañño kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattippatto.
segments.mnd16:61.7: apacinitvā ṭhito neva pajahati, na upādiyati;
segments.mnd16:61.8: pajahitvā ṭhito neva saṃsibbati, na usineti;
segments.mnd16:61.9: visinetvā ṭhito neva vidhūpeti, na sandhūpeti;
segments.mnd16:61.10: vidhūpetvā ṭhito, asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgatattā ṭhito, asekhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgatattā ṭhito, asekhena paññākkhandhena samannāgatattā ṭhito, asekhena vimuttikkhandhena samannāgatattā ṭhito, asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgatattā ṭhito, saccaṃ sampaṭipādiyitvā ṭhito, ejaṃ samatikkamitvā ṭhito, kilesaggiṃ pariyādiyitvā ṭhito, aparigamanatāya ṭhito, kaṭaṃ samādāya ṭhito, muttapaṭisevanatāya ṭhito, mettāya pārisuddhiyā ṭhito, karuṇāya pārisuddhiyā ṭhito, muditāya pārisuddhiyā ṭhito, upekkhāya pārisuddhiyā ṭhito, accantapārisuddhiyā ṭhito, atammayatāya pārisuddhiyā ṭhito, vimuttattā ṭhito, santusitattā ṭhito, khandhapariyante ṭhito, dhātupariyante ṭhito, āyatanapariyante ṭhito, gatipariyante ṭhito, upapattipariyante ṭhito, paṭisandhipariyante ṭhito, bhavapariyante ṭhito, saṃsārapariyante ṭhito, vaṭṭapariyante ṭhito, antime bhave ṭhito, antime samussaye ṭhito, antimadehadharo bhagavā.
segments.mnd16:64.2: Bhagavato rāgā cittaṃ muttaṃ vimuttaṃ suvimuttaṃ, dosā cittaṃ … mohā cittaṃ … kodhā … upanāhā … makkhā … paḷāsā … issāya … macchariyā … māyāya … sāṭheyyā … thambhā … sārambhā … mānā … atimānā … madā … pamādā … sabbakilesehi … sabbaduccaritehi … sabbadarathehi … sabbapariḷāhehi … sabbasantāpehi … sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārehi cittaṃ muttaṃ vimuttaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
segments.mnd16:65.2: Bhagavā sīle sati sīlavāti taṃniddesā tādī, saddhāya sati saddhoti taṃniddesā tādī, vīriye sati vīriyavāti taṃniddesā tādī, satiyā sati satimāti taṃniddesā tādī, samādhismiṃ sati samāhitoti taṃniddesā tādī, paññāya sati paññavāti taṃniddesā tādī, vijjāya sati tevijjoti taṃniddesā tādī, abhiññāya sati chaḷabhiññoti taṃniddesā tādī, dasabale sati dasabaloti taṃniddesā tādī.
segments.mnd16:66.3: paccayapaṭisevanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, iriyāpathasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, sāmantajappanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu.
segments.mnd16:67.3: So pāpiccho icchāpakato atthiko [atittiko (sī.), itthiko (syā.), purābhedasuttaniddese pāṭhanānattaṃ natthi] cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya cīvaraṃ paccakkhāti, piṇḍapātaṃ paccakkhāti, senāsanaṃ paccakkhāti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paccakkhāti.
segments.mnd16:67.6: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ, yaṃ samaṇo susānā vā saṅkārakūṭā vā pāpaṇikā vā nantakāni uccinitvā saṅghāṭiṃ karitvā dhāreyya.
segments.mnd16:67.8: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ, yaṃ samaṇo uñchācariyāya piṇḍiyālopena jīvitaṃ kappeyya.
segments.mnd16:67.10: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ, yaṃ samaṇo rukkhamūliko vā assa sosāniko vā abbhokāsiko vā.
segments.mnd16:67.12: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ, yaṃ samaṇo pūtimuttena haritakīkhaṇḍena osadhaṃ kareyyā”ti tadupādāya lūkhaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti, lūkhaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjati, lūkhaṃ senāsanaṃ paṭisevati, lūkhaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭisevati.
segments.mnd16:67.14: “ayaṃ samaṇo appiccho santuṭṭho pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho āraddhavīriyo dhutavādo”ti bhiyyo bhiyyo nimantenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi.
segments.mnd16:67.16: “tiṇṇaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, saddhāya sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, deyyadhammassa sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, dakkhiṇeyyānaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati.
segments.mnd16:67.17: Tumhākañcevāyaṃ saddhā atthi, deyyadhammo ca saṃvijjati, ahañca paṭiggāhako.
segments.mnd16:67.18: Sace ahaṃ na paṭiggahessāmi, evaṃ tumhe puññena paribāhirā [paṭibāhirā (ka.)] bhavissatha, na mayhaṃ iminā attho, api ca tumhākaṃyeva anukampāya paṭiggaṇhāmī”ti.
segments.mnd16:67.19: Tadupādāya bahumpi cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti [paṭigaṇhati (sī.)], bahumpi piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, bahumpi senāsanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, bahumpi gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti.
segments.mnd16:67.20: Yā evarūpā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ –
segments.mnd16:68.2: Idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo,“evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatī”ti gamanaṃ saṇṭhapeti, ṭhānaṃ saṇṭhapeti, nisajjaṃ saṇṭhapeti, sayanaṃ saṇṭhapeti, paṇidhāya gacchati, paṇidhāya tiṭṭhati, paṇidhāya nisīdati, paṇidhāya seyyaṃ kappeti, samāhito viya gacchati, samāhito viya tiṭṭhati, samāhito viya nisīdati, samāhito viya seyyaṃ kappeti, āpāthakajjhāyīva hoti.
segments.mnd16:68.3: Yā evarūpā iriyāpathassa āṭhapanā ṭhapanā saṇṭhapanā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ –
segments.mnd16:69.2: Idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo “evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatī”ti, ariyadhammasannissitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati.
segments.mnd16:69.3: “Yo evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd16:69.11: āyogaṃ dhāreti, so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd16:69.12: “yassa evarūpo upajjhāyo so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd16:69.20: “yo evarūpe vihāre vasati, so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd16:69.33: rukkhamūle vasati, so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati.
segments.mnd16:70.1: Atha vā korajikakorajiko, bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko, kuhakakuhako, lapakalapako, mukhasambhāvito “ayaṃ samaṇo imāsaṃ evarūpānaṃ vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī”ti.
segments.mnd16:70.2: Tādisaṃ gambhīraṃ gūḷhaṃ nipuṇaṃ paṭicchannaṃ lokuttaraṃ suññatāpaṭisaññuttaṃ kathaṃ katheti.
segments.mnd16:70.3: Yā evarūpā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ –
segments.mnd16:70.5: Buddhassa bhagavato imāni tīṇi kuhanavatthūni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni.
segments.mnd16:71.3: Gaṇācariyoti gaṇī, gaṇassa satthāti gaṇī, gaṇaṃ pariharatīti gaṇī, gaṇaṃ ovadatīti gaṇī, gaṇaṃ anusāsatīti gaṇī, visārado gaṇaṃ upasaṅkamatīti gaṇī, gaṇassa sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapetīti gaṇī, gaṇaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetīti gaṇī, bhikkhugaṇassa gaṇī, bhikkhunīgaṇassa gaṇī, upāsakagaṇassa gaṇī, upāsikāgaṇassa gaṇī, rājagaṇassa gaṇī, khattiyagaṇassa gaṇī, brāhmaṇagaṇassa gaṇī, vessagaṇassa gaṇī, suddagaṇassa gaṇī, brahmagaṇassa gaṇī, devagaṇassa gaṇī, saṅghiṃ [saṃghagaṇassa gaṇī (sī.)] gaṇiṃ gaṇācariyaṃ.
segments.mnd16:72.2: Bahūnaṃ khattiyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vessānaṃ suddānaṃ gahaṭṭhānaṃ pabbajitānaṃ devānaṃ manussānaṃ.
segments.mnd16:73.2: Pañhena atthiko āgatomhi [atthikāmha āgatā (sī. ka.) evamīdisesu dvīsu padesupi bahuvacanena], pañhaṃ pucchitukāmo āgatomhi, pañhaṃ sotukāmo āgatomhīti.
segments.mnd16:73.4: Atha vā pañhatthikānaṃ pañhaṃ pucchitukāmānaṃ pañhaṃ sotukāmānaṃ āgamanaṃ abhikkamanaṃ upasaṅkamanaṃ payirupāsanaṃ [payirupāsanā (syā. ka.)] siyā atthīti.
segments.mnd16:73.6: Atha vā pañhāgamo tuyhaṃ atthi, tvampi pahu [imāni tīṇi padāni natthi syā. potthake], tvamasi alamattho mayā pucchitaṃ kathetuṃ visajjetuṃ “vahassetaṃ bhāran”ti.
segments.mnd16:77.2: Bhikkhunoti puthujjanakalyāṇassa vā bhikkhuno sekkhassa vā bhikkhuno.
segments.mnd16:77.3: Vijigucchatoti jātiyā vijigucchato, jarāya … byādhinā … maraṇena … sokehi … paridevehi … dukkhehi … domanassehi … upāyāsehi vijigucchato, nerayikena dukkhena … tiracchānayonikena dukkhena … pettivisayikena dukkhena … mānusikena [mānusakena (sī. syā.) mahāni.171] dukkhena … gabbhokkantimūlakena dukkhena … gabbhaṭṭhitimūlakena dukkhena … gabbhavuṭṭhānamūlakena dukkhena … jātassūpanibandhakena dukkhena … jātassa parādheyyakena dukkhena … attūpakkamena dukkhena … parūpakkamena dukkhena … dukkhadukkhena … saṅkhāradukkhena … vipariṇāmadukkhena … cakkhurogena dukkhena … sotarogena dukkhena … ghānarogena dukkhena … jivhārogena dukkhena … kāyarogena dukkhena … sīsarogena dukkhena … kaṇṇarogena dukkhena … mukharogena dukkhena … dantarogena dukkhena … kāsena … sāsena … pināsena … ḍāhena … jarena … kucchirogena … mucchāya … pakkhandikāya … sūlāya … visūcikāya … kuṭṭhena … gaṇḍena … kilāsena … sosena … apamārena … dadduyā … kaṇḍuyā … kacchuyā … rakhasāya … vitacchikāya … lohitena … pittena … madhumehena … aṃsāya … piḷakāya … bhagandalena … pittasamuṭṭhānena ābādhena … semhasamuṭṭhānena ābādhena … vātasamuṭṭhānena ābādhena … sannipātikena ābādhena … utupariṇāmajena ābādhena … visamaparihārajena ābādhena … opakkamikena ābādhena … kammavipākajena ābādhena … sītena … uṇhena … jighacchāya … pipāsāya … uccārena … passāvena … ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassena dukkhena … mātumaraṇena dukkhena … pitumaraṇena dukkhena … bhātumaraṇena … bhaginimaraṇena … puttamaraṇena … dhītumaraṇena … ñātibyasanena … bhogabyasanena … rogabyasanena … sīlabyasanena … diṭṭhibyasanena dukkhena vijigucchato aṭṭīyato harāyato jigucchatoti –
segments.mnd16:78.3: mañco pīṭhaṃ bhisi taṭṭikā cammakhaṇḍo tiṇasanthāro paṇṇasanthāro palālasanthāro [palāsasanthāro (sī. syā.)].
segments.mnd16:78.4: Taṃ āsanaṃ asappāyarūpadassanena rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ, asappāyasaddassavanena rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ, asappāyehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ.
segments.mnd16:78.5: Taṃ pavivittaṃ āsanaṃ bhajato sambhajato sevato nisevato saṃsevato paṭisevatoti –
segments.mnd16:79.5: Pabbatāyeva pabbatā, kandarāyeva kandarā, giriguhāyeva giriguhā.
segments.mnd16:83.3: Sayanaṃ vuccati senāsanaṃ vihāro aḍḍhayogo pāsādo hammiyaṃ guhāti –
segments.mnd16:83.6: Kivantoti kivanto [kuvanto (sī.), gīvanto (syā.)] kūjanto nadanto saddaṃ karonto.
segments.mnd16:83.7: Atha vā kivantoti kati kittakā kīvatakā kīvabahukā te.
segments.mnd16:83.8: Bheravāti sīhā byagghā dīpī acchā taracchā kokā mahiṃsā hatthī ahi vicchikā satapadī, corā vā assu mānavā vā katakammā vā akatakammā vāti – kivanto tattha bheravā.
segments.mnd16:84.2: Ye hīti ye hi bherave passitvā vā suṇitvā vā na vedheyya nappavedheyya na sampavedheyya na taseyya na uttaseyya na parittaseyya na bhāyeyya na santāsaṃ āpajjeyya, abhīrū assa acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī, pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃso vihareyyāti –
segments.mnd16:85.2: Appasadde appanigghose vijanavāte manussarāhasseyyake paṭisallānasāruppe senāsaneti –
segments.mnd16:89.6: Sīhā byagghā dīpī acchā taracchā kokā mahiṃsā hatthī ahi vicchikā satapadī, corā vā assu mānavā vā katakammā vā akatakammā vā, cakkhurogo sotarogo ghānarogo jivhārogo kāyarogo sīsarogo kaṇṇarogo mukharogo dantarogo kāso sāso pināso ḍāho jaro kucchirogo mucchā pakkhandikā sūlā visūcikā kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso soso apamāro daddu kaṇḍu kacchu rakhasā vitacchikā lohitaṃ pittaṃ madhumeho aṃsā piḷakā bhagandalā, pittasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā … pe …
segments.mnd16:89.7: sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassā –
segments.mnd16:90.2: Kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ rāgo doso moho kodho upanāho makkho paḷāso issā macchariyaṃ māyā sāṭheyyaṃ thambho sārambho māno atimāno mado pamādo, sabbe kilesā sabbe duccaritā sabbe darathā sabbe pariḷāhā sabbe santāpā sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārā –
segments.mnd16:91.2: Parisahantīti parissayā, parihānāya saṃvattantīti parissayā, tatrāsayāti parissayā.
segments.mnd16:92.2: Te parissayā taṃ puggalaṃ sahanti parisahanti abhibhavanti ajjhottharanti pariyādiyanti maddanti.
segments.mnd16:93.2: Te parissayā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ antarāyāya parihānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.mnd16:93.4: Sammāpaṭipadāya anulomapaṭipadāya apaccanīkapaṭipadāya aviruddhapaṭipadāya anvatthapaṭipadāya dhammānudhammapaṭipadāya sīlesu paripūrakāritāya indriyesu guttadvāratāya bhojane mattaññutāya jāgariyānuyogassa satisampajaññassa catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvanānuyogassa catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ pañcannaṃ balānaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa bhāvanānuyogassa –
segments.mnd16:93.5: imesaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ antarāyāya parihānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.mnd16:94.2: Tatthete pāpakā akusalā dhammā uppajjanti attabhāvasannissayā.
segments.mnd16:94.3: Yathā bile bilāsayā pāṇā sayanti, dake dakāsayā pāṇā sayanti, vane vanāsayā pāṇā sayanti, rukkhe rukkhāsayā pāṇā sayanti;
segments.mnd16:94.4: evameva tatthete pāpakā akusalā dhammā uppajjanti attabhāvasannissayāti.
segments.mnd16:96.1: “Sāntevāsiko, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sācariyako dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharati.
segments.mnd16:96.2: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sāntevāsiko sācariyako dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharati?
segments.mnd16:96.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā, tyassa anto vasanti anvāssavanti pāpakā akusalā dhammāti.
segments.mnd16:96.5: Te naṃ samudācaranti, samudācaranti naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammāti.
segments.mnd16:97.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā … pe …
segments.mnd16:97.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā, tyassa anto vasanti anvāssavanti pāpakā akusalā dhammāti.
segments.mnd16:97.7: Te naṃ samudācaranti, samudācaranti naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammāti.
segments.mnd16:97.9: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sāntevāsiko sācariyako dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharatī”ti.
segments.mnd16:99.1: “Tayome, bhikkhave, antarāmalā antarāamittā antarāsapattā antarāvadhakā antarāpaccatthikā.
segments.mnd16:99.3: Lobho, bhikkhave, antarāmalo antarāamitto antarāsapatto antarāvadhako antarāpaccatthiko,
segments.mnd16:99.5: moho, bhikkhave, antarāmalo antarāamitto antarāsapatto antarāvadhako antarāpaccatthiko.
segments.mnd16:99.6: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo antarāmalā antarāamittā antarāsapattā antarāvadhakā antarāpaccatthikā”.
segments.mnd16:101.3: Andhantamaṃ [andhatamaṃ (syā. ka.) mahāni.156; itivu.88] tadā hoti,
segments.mnd16:107.1: “Tayo kho, mahārāja, purisassa dhammā ajjhattaṃ uppajjamānā uppajjanti ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.mnd16:107.3: Lobho kho, mahārāja, purisassa dhammo ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya;
segments.mnd16:107.5: moho kho, mahārāja, purisassa dhammo ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.mnd16:107.6: Ime kho, mahārāja, tayo purisassa dhammā ajjhattaṃ uppajjamānā uppajjanti ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāyā”ti.
segments.mnd16:113.3: Yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
segments.mnd16:113.4: Agatapubbā sā disā na sā disā gatapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā.
segments.mnd16:116.2: Yeti ye parissaye abhisambhaveyya abhibhaveyya ajjhotthareyya pariyādiyeyya maddeyyāti –
segments.mnd16:117.2: Ante pante pariyante selante vā vanante vā nadante vā udakante vā yattha na kasīyati na vapīyati, janantaṃ atikkamitvā manussānaṃ anupacāre senāsaneti –
segments.mnd16:121.2: Kīdisena byappathena samannāgato assa kiṃsaṇṭhitena kiṃpakārena kiṃpaṭibhāgenāti vacīpārisuddhiṃ pucchati.
segments.mnd16:121.4: Idha bhikkhu musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
segments.mnd16:121.5: Pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya, iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā, sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mnd16:121.6: Pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti;
segments.mnd16:121.7: yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mnd16:121.8: Samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī, nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
segments.mnd16:121.9: Catūhi vacīsucaritehi samannāgato catudosāpagataṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, bāttiṃsāya tiracchānakathāya ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati.
segments.mnd16:121.11: appicchakathaṃ santuṭṭhikathaṃ pavivekakathaṃ asaṃsaggakathaṃ vīriyārambhakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ samādhikathaṃ paññākathaṃ vimuttikathaṃ vimuttiñāṇadassanakathaṃ satipaṭṭhānakathaṃ sammappadhānakathaṃ iddhipādakathaṃ indriyakathaṃ balakathaṃ bojjhaṅgakathaṃ maggakathaṃ phalakathaṃ nibbānakathaṃ katheti.
segments.mnd16:121.12: Vācāya yato yatto paṭiyatto gutto gopito rakkhito saṃvuto –
segments.mnd16:122.2: Kīdisena gocarena samannāgato assa kiṃsaṇṭhitena kiṃpakārena kiṃpaṭibhāgenāti gocaraṃ pucchati.
segments.mnd16:123.2: Idhekacco vesiyāgocaro vā hoti, vidhavāgocaro vā hoti, thullakumārīgocaro [thūlakumārīgocaro (syā. ka.)] vā hoti, paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti, bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti, pānāgāragocaro vā hoti, saṃsaṭṭho viharati rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi ananulomikena saṃsaggena.
segments.mnd16:123.3: Yāni vā pana tāni kulāni assaddhāni appasannāni anopānabhūtāni akkosakaparibhāsakāni anatthakāmāni ahitakāmāni aphāsukāmāni ayogakkhemakāmāni bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ, tathārūpāni kulāni sevati bhajati payirupāsati –
segments.mnd16:124.1: Atha vā antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vīthiṃ paṭipanno asaṃvuto gacchati, hatthiṃ olokento, assaṃ olokento, rathaṃ olokento, pattiṃ olokento, itthiyo olokento, purise olokento, kumārikāyo olokento, kumārake olokento, antarāpaṇaṃ olokento, gharamukhāni olokento, uddhaṃ olokento [ullokento (sī. ka.) mahāni.157 natthi pāṭhanānattaṃ], adho olokento, disāvidisaṃ vipekkhamāno gacchati –
segments.mnd16:125.1: Atha vā cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.mnd16:125.3: manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa na saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati –
segments.mnd16:126.1: Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ visūkadassanaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.mnd16:126.2: naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ pāṇissaraṃ vetāḷaṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ sobhanakaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vaṃsaṃ dhovanaṃ hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ nibbuddhaṃ uyyodhikaṃ balaggaṃ senābyūhaṃ anīkadassanaṃ iti vā iti, evarūpaṃ visūkadassanaṃ anuyutto hoti –
segments.mnd16:127.4: Agocare, bhikkhave, carataṃ paravisaye lacchati māro otāraṃ, lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.mnd16:127.5: Ko ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo?
segments.mnd16:127.8: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
segments.mnd16:127.12: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.mnd16:127.13: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo”–
segments.mnd16:128.2: Idha bhikkhu na vesiyāgocaro hoti, na vidhavāgocaro hoti, na thullakumārīgocaro hoti, na paṇḍakagocaro hoti, na bhikkhunīgocaro hoti, na pānāgāragocaro hoti, asaṃsaṭṭho viharati rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi ananulomikena saṃsaggena.
segments.mnd16:128.3: Yāni vā pana tāni kulāni saddhāni pasannāni opānabhūtāni kāsāvapajjotāni isivātapaṭivātāni atthakāmāni hitakāmāni phāsukāmāni yogakkhemakāmāni bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ, tathārūpāni kulāni sevati bhajati payirupāsati –
segments.mnd16:129.1: Atha vā bhikkhu antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vīthiṃ paṭipanno saṃvuto gacchati, na hatthiṃ olokento, na assaṃ olokento, na rathaṃ olokento, na pattiṃ olokento … pe …

segments.mnd16:131.1: Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ visūkadassanaṃ ananuyuttā viharanti, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.mnd16:131.2: naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ … pe … anīkadassanaṃ iti vā iti, evarūpā visūkadassanā paṭivirato hoti –
segments.mnd16:132.4: Gocare, bhikkhave, carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati māro otāraṃ, na lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.mnd16:132.5: Ko ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo?
segments.mnd16:132.8: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati,
segments.mnd16:132.11: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
segments.mnd16:132.12: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo –
segments.mnd16:133.2: Kīdisena sīlabbatena samannāgato assa kiṃsaṇṭhitena kiṃpakārena kiṃpaṭibhāgenāti sīlabbatapārisuddhiṃ pucchati.
segments.mnd16:133.4: Atthi sīlañceva vatañca, atthi vataṃ na sīlaṃ.
segments.mnd16:133.6: Idha bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
segments.mnd16:134.3: āraññikaṅgaṃ, piṇḍapātikaṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ, tecīvarikaṅgaṃ, sapadānacārikaṅgaṃ, khalupacchābhattikaṅgaṃ, nesajjikaṅgaṃ, yathāsanthatikaṅgaṃ –
segments.mnd16:134.6: Kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisabalena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti –
segments.mnd16:134.8: Evarūpampi vīriyasamādānaṃ vuccati vataṃ na sīlaṃ.

segments.mnd16:136.21: rukkhamūlā nikkhamissāmi yāva me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccissatīti –
segments.mnd16:136.23: Evarūpampi vīriyasamādānaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ.
segments.mnd16:136.24: Imasmiññeva pubbaṇhasamayaṃ ariyadhammaṃ āharissāmi samāharissāmi adhigacchissāmi phassayissāmi sacchikarissāmīti –
segments.mnd16:136.26: Evarūpampi vīriyasamādānaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ.

segments.mnd16:136.43: Evarūpampi vīriyasamādānaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ –
segments.mnd16:137.2: Pahitattassāti āraddhavīriyassa thāmagatassa daḷhaparakkamassa anikkhittacchandassa anikkhittadhurassa kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mnd16:137.3: Atha vā pesitattassa yassatthāya pesito attatthe ca ñāye ca lakkhaṇe ca kāraṇe ca ṭhānāṭhāne ca.
segments.mnd16:137.17: channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca pesitattassa,
segments.mnd16:137.19: catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca pesitattassa,
segments.mnd16:137.20: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma” ntntti pesitattassa.
segments.mnd16:137.21: Bhikkhunoti puthujjanakalyāṇakassa vā bhikkhuno sekkhassa vā bhikkhunoti –
segments.mnd16:141.1: Kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāyāti kaṃ so sikkhaṃ ādāya samādāya ādiyitvā samādiyitvā gaṇhitvā parāmasitvā abhinivisitvāti –
segments.mnd16:142.2: Ekodīti ekaggacitto avikkhittacitto avisāhaṭamānaso samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd16:142.4: Nipakoti nipako paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī.
segments.mnd16:142.12: Kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāyāti adhisīlasikkhaṃ pucchati.
segments.mnd16:142.16: kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya, ekodi nipako sato.
segments.mnd16:143.2: Kammāro vuccati suvaṇṇakāro, rajataṃ vuccati jātarūpaṃ.
segments.mnd16:143.3: Yathā suvaṇṇakāro jātarūpassa oḷārikampi malaṃ dhamati sandhamati niddhamati, majjhimakampi malaṃ dhamati sandhamati niddhamati, sukhumakampi malaṃ dhamati sandhamati niddhamati;
segments.mnd16:143.4: evameva bhikkhu attano oḷārikepi kilese dhamati sandhamati niddhamati pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gameti, majjhimakepi kilese … sukhumakepi kilese dhamati sandhamati niddhamati pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mnd16:144.1: Atha vā bhikkhu attano rāgamalaṃ dosamalaṃ mohamalaṃ mānamalaṃ diṭṭhimalaṃ kilesamalaṃ duccaritamalaṃ andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhikaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ dhamati sandhamati niddhamati pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mnd16:145.1: Atha vā sammādiṭṭhiyā micchādiṭṭhiṃ dhamati sandhamati niddhamati pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mnd16:145.10: sammāvimuttiyā micchāvimuttiṃ dhamati sandhamati niddhamati pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mnd16:146.1: Atha vā ariyena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena sabbe kilese sabbe duccarite sabbe darathe sabbe pariḷāhe sabbe santāpe sabbākusalābhisaṅkhāre dhamati sandhamati niddhamati pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gametīti –
segments.mnd16:150.2: Vijigucchamānassāti jātiyā vijigucchamānassa, jarāya … byādhinā … maraṇena … sokehi … paridevehi … dukkhehi … domanassehi … upāyāsehi … pe …
segments.mnd16:150.3: diṭṭhibyasanena dukkhena vijigucchamānassa aṭṭīyamānassa [aṭṭiyamānassa (syā. ka.)] harāyamānassāti –
segments.mnd16:150.7: Sammāpaṭipadā anulomapaṭipadā apaccanīkapaṭipadā aviruddhapaṭipadā anvatthapaṭipadā dhammānudhammapaṭipadā sīlesu paripūrakāritā indriyesu guttadvāratā bhojane mattaññutā jāgariyānuyogo satisampajaññaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo nibbānañca nibbānagāminī ca paṭipadā –
segments.mnd16:151.11: bhaji vibhaji pavibhaji [paṭibhaji (sī. syā.) mahāni.50 natthi pāṭhanānattaṃ] dhammaratananti bhagavā,
segments.mnd16:151.14: bhaji vā bhagavā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppānīti bhagavā,
segments.mnd16:151.16: bhāgī vā bhagavā attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa adhisīlassa adhicittassa adhipaññāyāti bhagavā,
segments.mnd16:151.17: bhāgī vā bhagavā catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ catunnaṃ appamaññānaṃ catunnaṃ āruppasamāpattīnanti bhagavā,
segments.mnd16:151.18: bhāgī vā bhagavā aṭṭhannaṃ vimokkhānaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ abhiññāyatanānaṃ navannaṃ anupubbavihārasamāpattīnanti bhagavā,
segments.mnd16:151.19: bhāgī vā bhagavā dasannaṃ saññābhāvanānaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇasamāpattīnaṃ ānāpānassatisamādhissa asubhasamāpattiyāti bhagavā,
segments.mnd16:151.20: bhāgī vā bhagavā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ pañcannaṃ balānaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassāti bhagavā,
segments.mnd16:151.21: bhāgī vā bhagavā dasannaṃ tathāgatabalānaṃ catunnaṃ vesārajjānaṃ catunnaṃ paṭisambhidānaṃ channaṃ abhiññānaṃ channaṃ buddhadhammānanti bhagavā;
segments.mnd16:151.22: bhagavāti netaṃ nāmaṃ mātarā kataṃ, na pitarā kataṃ, na bhātarā kataṃ, na bhaginiyā kataṃ, na mittāmaccehi kataṃ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ, na devatāhi kataṃ;
segments.mnd16:151.23: vimokkhantikametaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutañāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ bhagavāti –
segments.mnd16:152.3: mañco pīṭhaṃ bhisi taṭṭikā cammakhaṇḍo tiṇasanthāro paṇṇasanthāro palālasanthāro.
segments.mnd16:152.4: Sayanaṃ vuccati senāsanaṃ vihāro aḍḍhayogo pāsādo hammiyaṃ guhā.
segments.mnd16:152.5: Taṃ sayanāsanaṃ asappāyarūpadassanena rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ, asappāyasaddassavanena … pe …
segments.mnd16:152.6: asappāyehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ.
segments.mnd16:152.7: Taṃ sayanāsanaṃ sevato nisevato saṃsevato paṭisevatoti –
segments.mnd16:153.2: Sambodhi vuccati catūsu maggesu ñāṇaṃ paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd16:153.4: Taṃ sambodhiṃ bujjhitukāmassa anubujjhitukāmassa paṭibujjhitukāmassa sambujjhitukāmassa adhigantukāmassa phassitukāmassa sacchikātukāmassāti –
segments.mnd16:154.2: Sammāpaṭipadā anulomapaṭipadā apaccanīkapaṭipadā aviruddhapaṭipadā anvatthapaṭipadā dhammānudhammapaṭipadā sīlesu paripūrakāritā indriyesu guttadvāratā bhojane mattaññutā jāgariyānuyogo satisampajaññaṃ –
segments.mnd16:154.4: Atha vā catunnaṃ maggānaṃ pubbabhāge vipassanā –
segments.mnd16:155.3: Pavakkhāmīti pavakkhāmi ācikkhissāmi desessāmi paññapessāmi paṭhapessāmi vivarissāmi vibhajissāmi uttānīkarissāmi pakāsissāmi.
segments.mnd16:155.4: Yathā pajānanti yathā pajānaṃ yathā pajānanto ājānanto vijānanto paṭivijānanto paṭivijjhanto na itihitihaṃ na itikirāya na paramparāya na piṭakasampadāya na takkahetu na nayahetu na ākāraparivitakkena na diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā sāmaṃ sayamabhiññātaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ dhammaṃ, taṃ kathayissāmīti –
segments.mnd16:159.2: Dhīroti dhīro paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī.
segments.mnd16:159.3: Dhīro pañcannaṃ bhayānaṃ na bhāyeyya na taseyya na santaseyya na uttaseyya na parittaseyya na santāsaṃ āpajjeyya, abhīrū assa acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃso vihareyyāti –
segments.mnd16:160.2: Bhikkhūti puthujjanakalyāṇako vā bhikkhu sekkho vā bhikkhu.
segments.mnd16:161.2: Idha bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
segments.mnd16:161.3: Antopūtibhāvaṃ paccavekkhamāno anto sīlasaṃvarapariyante carati, mariyādaṃ na bhindati –
segments.mnd16:162.2: Idha bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.mnd16:162.5: Sotena saddaṃ sutvā … ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā … jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā … kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā … manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.mnd16:162.6: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ susaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.mnd16:162.7: Ādittapariyāyaṃ paccavekkhamāno anto indriyasaṃvarapariyante carati, mariyādaṃ na bhindati –
segments.mnd16:163.2: Idha bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya.
segments.mnd16:163.3: Iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
segments.mnd16:163.4: Akkhabbhañjanavaṇapaṭicchādanaputtamaṃsūpamaṃ paccavekkhamāno anto bhojane mattaññutāpariyante carati, mariyādaṃ na bhindati –
segments.mnd16:164.2: Idha bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti, rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti, rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā, rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
segments.mnd16:164.3: Bhaddekarattavihāraṃ [bhaddekarattivihāraṃ (sī. ka.)] paccavekkhamāno anto jāgariyānuyogapariyante carati, mariyādaṃ na bhindati –
segments.mnd16:166.2: Manussaphassā vuccanti corā vā assu mānavā vā katakammā vā akatakammā vā.
segments.mnd16:166.3: Te bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ vā puccheyyuṃ vādaṃ vā āropeyyuṃ akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ.
segments.mnd16:166.6: Catuppadānanti sīhā byagghā dīpi acchā taracchā kokā mahiṃsā hatthī.
segments.mnd16:166.7: Te bhikkhuṃ maddeyyuṃ khādeyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ.
segments.mnd16:170.2: Paradhammikā vuccanti satta sahadhammike ṭhapetvā ye keci buddhe dhamme saṅghe appasannā.
segments.mnd16:170.3: Te bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ vā puccheyyuṃ vādaṃ vā āropeyyuṃ akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ.
segments.mnd16:170.4: Tesaṃ bahubherave passitvā vā suṇitvā vā na vedheyya na pavedheyya na sampavedheyya na taseyya na santaseyya na uttaseyya na parittaseyya na bhāyeyya na santāsaṃ āpajjeyya, abhīrū assa acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃso vihareyyāti –
segments.mnd16:170.5: paradhammikānampi na santaseyya disvāpi tesaṃ bahubheravāni.
segments.mnd16:171.2: Athāparānipi atthi abhisambhotabbāni abhibhavitabbāni ajjhottharitabbāni pariyādiyitabbāni madditabbāni.
segments.mnd16:171.7: Kusalānuesīti sammāpaṭipadaṃ anulomapaṭipadaṃ apaccanīkapaṭipadaṃ aviruddhapaṭipadaṃ anvatthapaṭipadaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd16:171.8: ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ nibbānañca nibbānagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ esantena gavesantena pariyesantena parissayā abhisambhotabbā abhibhavitabbā ajjhottharitabbā pariyādiyitabbā madditabbāti –
segments.mnd16:175.3: Rogaphassena phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato assa;
segments.mnd16:175.4: cakkhurogena phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato assa,
segments.mnd16:175.9: ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassena phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato assa.
segments.mnd16:175.11: Chātakena phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato assāti –
segments.mnd16:176.3: abbhantaradhātuppakopavasena [abbhantaradhātusaṅkopavasena (syā.)] vā sītaṃ hoti, bahiddhā utuvasena vā sītaṃ hoti.
segments.mnd16:176.5: abbhantaradhātuppakopavasena vā uṇhaṃ hoti, bahiddhā utuvasena vā uṇhaṃ hotīti –
segments.mnd16:176.7: Adhivāsayeyyāti khamo assa sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ [tippānaṃ (sī. syā.)] kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko assāti –
segments.mnd16:177.2: So tehīti ātaṅkaphassena ca khudāya ca sītena ca uṇhena ca phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato assāti –
segments.mnd16:177.4: Bahudhāti anekavidhehi ākārehi phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato assāti –
segments.mnd16:177.8: Atha vā kāyaduccaritassa vacīduccaritassa manoduccaritassa okāsaṃ na karotītipi –
segments.mnd16:178.2: Vīriyaparakkamo vuccati yo cetasiko vīriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī appaṭivānī thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittacchandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo.
segments.mnd16:178.4: Vīriyaṃ parakkamaṃ daḷhaṃ kareyya thiraṃ kareyya, daḷhasamādāno assa avatthitasamādānoti –
segments.mnd16:182.2: Theyyaṃ na kāreti idha bhikkhu adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato assa dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī, athenena sucibhūtena attanā vihareyyāti –
segments.mnd16:182.4: Na musā bhaṇeyyāti idha bhikkhu musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato assa saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassāti –
segments.mnd16:182.5: theyyaṃ na kāre na musā bhaṇeyya.
segments.mnd16:183.2: Mettāti yā sattesu metti mettāyanā mettāyitattaṃ anudayā anudayanā anudayitattaṃ [anuddayā (sī.) evamīdisesu dvīsu padesupi dvibhāvavasena. anudā anudāyanā anudāyitattaṃ (syā. ka.)] hitesitā anukampā abyāpādo abyāpajjo [abyāpajjho (syā. ka.)] adoso kusalamūlaṃ.
segments.mnd16:183.3: Tasāti yesaṃ tasitā taṇhā appahīnā, yesañca bhayabheravā appahīnā.
segments.mnd16:183.5: Te tasanti uttasanti paritasanti bhāyanti santāsaṃ āpajjanti;
segments.mnd16:183.7: Thāvarāti yesaṃ tasitā taṇhā pahīnā, yesañca bhayabheravā pahīnā.
segments.mnd16:183.9: Te na tasanti na uttasanti na paritasanti na bhāyanti santāsaṃ na āpajjanti;
segments.mnd16:183.12: Tase ca thāvare ca mettāya phasseyya phareyya, mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā vihareyyāti –
segments.mnd16:184.3: Manasoti yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu.
segments.mnd16:184.4: Kāyaduccaritena cittaṃ āvilaṃ hoti luḷitaṃ eritaṃ ghaṭṭitaṃ calitaṃ bhantaṃ avūpasantaṃ.
segments.mnd16:184.29: sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārehi cittaṃ āvilaṃ hoti luḷitaṃ eritaṃ ghaṭṭitaṃ calitaṃ bhantaṃ avūpasantaṃ.
segments.mnd16:184.31: Cittassa āvilabhāvaṃ jāneyya ājāneyya vijāneyya paṭivijāneyya paṭivijjheyyāti –
segments.mnd16:185.2: Kaṇhoti yo so māro kaṇho adhipati antagu namuci pamattabandhu.
segments.mnd16:185.3: Kaṇhassa pakkho mārapakkho mārapāso mārabaḷisaṃ mārāmisaṃ māravisayo māranivāso māragocaro mārabandhananti pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyāti.
segments.mnd16:185.5: Atha vā kaṇhassa pakkho mārapakkho akusalapakkho dukkhuddayo dukkhavipāko nirayasaṃvattaniko tiracchānayonisaṃvattaniko pettivisayasaṃvattanikoti pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyāti.
segments.mnd16:189.4: Atimānoti idhekacco paraṃ atimaññati jātiyā vā gottena vā … pe … aññataraññatarena vā vatthunā.
segments.mnd16:189.6: Kodhassa ca atimānassa ca vasaṃ na gaccheyya, kodhañca atimānañca pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyāti –
segments.mnd16:190.3: Avijjā mūlaṃ, ayoniso manasikāro mūlaṃ, asmimāno mūlaṃ, ahirikaṃ mūlaṃ, anottappaṃ mūlaṃ, uddhaccaṃ mūlaṃ –
segments.mnd16:190.6: Avijjā mūlaṃ, ayoniso manasikāro mūlaṃ, asmimāno mūlaṃ, ahirikaṃ mūlaṃ, anottappaṃ mūlaṃ, uddhaccaṃ mūlaṃ –
segments.mnd16:190.9: Kodhassa ca atimānassa ca mūlaṃ palikhaṇitvā uddharitvā samuddharitvā uppāṭayitvā samuppāṭayitvā pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā tiṭṭheyya santiṭṭheyyāti –
segments.mnd16:191.1: Athappiyaṃ vā pana appiyaṃ vā, addhā bhavanto abhisambhavaiyyāti.
segments.mnd16:191.2: Athāti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ –
segments.mnd16:191.7: Idha yāssa [yassa (syā.) suttamālā oloketabbā] te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukāmā yogakkhemakāmā mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā puttā vā dhītā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā –
segments.mnd16:191.18: Idha yāssa te honti anatthakāmā ahitakāmā aphāsukāmā ayogakkhemakāmā jīvitā voropetukāmā –
segments.mnd16:191.25: Addhāti ekaṃsavacanaṃ nissaṃsayavacanaṃ nikkaṅkhavacanaṃ advejjhavacanaṃ adveḷhakavacanaṃ niyyānikavacanaṃ apaṇṇakavacanaṃ avatthāpanavacanametaṃ –
segments.mnd16:191.27: Athappiyaṃ vā pana appiyaṃ vā, addhā bhavanto abhisambhaveyyāti.
segments.mnd16:191.28: Piyāppiyaṃ sātāsātaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ somanassadomanassaṃ iṭṭhāniṭṭhaṃ abhisambhavanto vā abhibhaveyya adhibhavanto vā abhisambhaveyyāti –
segments.mnd16:191.29: athappiyaṃ vā pana appiyaṃ vā addhā bhavanto abhisambhaveyya.
segments.mnd16:195.2: Paññāti yā paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo … pe …
segments.mnd16:195.4: Paññaṃ purakkhatvāti idhekacco paññaṃ purato katvā carati paññādhajo paññāketu paññādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo pekkhāyanabahulo [okkhāyanabahulo (bahūsu)] sampekkhāyanabahulo [samokkhāyanabahulo (sī. syā.)] vibhūtavihārī taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyoti.
segments.mnd16:196.1: Atha vā gacchanto vā “gacchāmī”ti pajānāti, ṭhito vā “ṭhitomhī”ti pajānāti, nisinno vā “nisinnomhī”ti pajānāti, sayāno vā “sayānomhī”ti pajānāti, yathā yathā vā panassa kāyo paṇihito hoti tathā tathā naṃ pajānātīti.
segments.mnd16:197.1: Atha vā abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhibhāve sampajānakārī hotīti.
segments.mnd16:198.3: Dhammānussati saṅghānussati sīlānussati cāgānussati devatānussati ānāpānassati maraṇassati kāyagatāsativasena upasamānussativasena uppajjati pīti pāmojjaṃ –
segments.mnd16:199.9: Tāni parissayāni vikkhambheyya abhibhaveyya ajjhotthareyya pariyādiyeyya maddeyyāti –
segments.mnd16:200.2: Aratīti yā arati aratitā anabhirati anabhiramaṇā [anabhiramanā (bahūsu) vibha.856] ukkaṇṭhitā paritassitā.
segments.mnd16:200.3: Sayanamhi panteti pantesu vā senāsanesu aññataraññataresu vā adhikusalesu dhammesu aratiṃ saheyya abhibhaveyya ajjhotthareyya pariyādiyeyya maddeyyāti –
segments.mnd16:201.2: Cattāro paridevanīye dhamme saheyya parisaheyya abhibhaveyya ajjhotthareyya pariyādiyeyya maddeyyāti –
segments.mnd16:204.1: Kiṃsū asissaṃ kuva vā [kuhiṃ vā (sī.), kuvaṃ vā (syā.), kutha vā (ka.)] asissaṃ,
segments.mnd16:205.2: Kiṃsū asissāmīti kiṃ bhuñjissāmi odanaṃ vā kummāsaṃ vā sattuṃ vā macchaṃ vā maṃsaṃ vāti –
segments.mnd16:205.4: Kuva vā asissanti kattha bhuñjissāmi khattiyakule vā brāhmaṇakule vā vessakule vā suddakule vāti –
segments.mnd16:206.1: Dukkhaṃ vata settha kuvajja sessanti imaṃ rattiṃ dukkhaṃ sayittha phalake vā taṭṭikāya vā cammakhaṇḍe vā tiṇasanthāre vā paṇṇasanthāre vā palālasanthāre vā.
segments.mnd16:206.2: Āgāmirattiṃ [āgamanarattiṃ (syā.)] kattha sukhaṃ sayissāmi mañce vā pīṭhe vā bhisiyā vā bimbohane vā vihāre vā aḍḍhayoge vā pāsāde vā hammiye vā guhāya vāti –
segments.mnd16:207.2: Ete vitakketi dve piṇḍapātapaṭisaññutte vitakke, dve senāsanapaṭisaññutte vitakke.
segments.mnd16:208.6: Adhisīlampi sikkhati, adhicittampi sikkhati, adhipaññampi sikkhati.
segments.mnd16:208.9: Imā tisso sikkhāyo āvajjanto sikkhati, jānanto passanto paccavekkhanto cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto sikkhati, saddhāya adhimuccanto sikkhati, vīriyaṃ paggaṇhanto, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento, cittaṃ samādahanto, paññāya pajānanto sikkhati, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto sikkhati, pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto, pahātabbaṃ pajahanto, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvento, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto sikkhati ācarati samācarati samādāya sikkhati.
segments.mnd16:208.12: Vinayāya paṭivinayāya pahānāya vūpasamāya paṭinissaggāya paṭipassaddhiyā adhisīlampi sikkheyya, adhicittampi sikkheyya, adhipaññampi sikkheyya.
segments.mnd16:208.13: Imā tisso sikkhāyo āvajjanto sikkheyya jānanto … pe …
segments.mnd16:208.14: sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto sikkheyya ācareyya samācareyya samādāya vatteyyāti –
segments.mnd16:209.3: Idhekacco kulapalibodhena samannāgato hoti, gaṇapalibodhena … āvāsapalibodhena … cīvarapalibodhena … piṇḍapātapalibodhena … senāsanapalibodhena … gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārapalibodhena samannāgato hoti.
segments.mnd16:209.6: Idha bhikkhu na kulapalibodhena samannāgato hoti, na gaṇapalibodhena … na āvāsapalibodhena … na cīvarapalibodhena … na piṇḍapātapalibodhena … na senāsanapalibodhena … na gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārapalibodhena samannāgato hoti.
segments.mnd16:214.2: mattaṃ sa jaññā [mattaṃ so jaññā (syā.)] idha tosanatthaṃ;
segments.mnd16:215.4: khomaṃ, kappāsikaṃ, koseyyaṃ, kambalaṃ, sāṇaṃ, bhaṅgaṃ.
segments.mnd16:215.6: Cīvaraṃ labhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ labhitvā na kuhanāya, na lapanāya, na nemittikatāya, na nippesikatāya, na lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanatāya, na dārudānena, na veḷudānena, na pattadānena, na pupphadānena, na phaladānena, na sinānadānena, na cuṇṇadānena, na mattikādānena, na dantakaṭṭhadānena, na mukhodakadānena, na cātukamyatāya, na muggasūpyatāya, na pāribhaṭyatāya, na pīṭhamaddikatāya, na vatthuvijjāya, na tiracchānavijjāya, na aṅgavijjāya, na nakkhattavijjāya, na dūtagamanena, na pahiṇagamanena, na jaṅghapesanikena, na vejjakammena, na piṇḍapaṭipiṇḍakena, na dānānuppadānena dhammena samena laddhā labhitvā adhigantvā vinditvā paṭilabhitvāti –
segments.mnd16:216.2: Mattaṃ sa jaññāti dvīhi kāraṇehi mattaṃ jāneyya –
segments.mnd16:216.5: Thokepi diyyamāne kulānudayāya [kulānuddayāya (sī. ka.)] kulānurakkhāya kulānukampāya paṭiggaṇhāti, bahukepi diyyamāne kāyaparihārikaṃ cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti kucchiparihārikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti.
segments.mnd16:217.1: Paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevati yāvadeva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāvadeva hirikopīnapaṭicchādanatthaṃ.
segments.mnd16:218.1: Paṭisaṅkhā yoniso piṇḍapātaṃ paṭisevati neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya.
segments.mnd16:218.2: Iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro ca.
segments.mnd16:219.1: Paṭisaṅkhā yoniso senāsanaṃ paṭisevati yāvadeva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāvadeva utuparissayavinodanapaṭisallānārāmatthaṃ.
segments.mnd16:220.1: Paṭisaṅkhā yoniso gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭisevati yāvadeva uppannānaṃ veyyābyādhikānaṃ [veyyābādhikānaṃ (sī. syā.)] vedanānaṃ paṭighātāya abyāpajjaparamatāya.
segments.mnd16:221.3: Imehi dvīhi kāraṇehi mattaṃ jāneyya ājāneyya paṭivijāneyya paṭivijjheyyāti –
segments.mnd16:222.2: Idha bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena cīvarena itarītaracīvarasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca cīvarahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati;
segments.mnd16:222.3: aladdhā ca cīvaraṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca cīvaraṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno, ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati;
segments.mnd16:222.4: tāya ca pana itarītaracīvarasantuṭṭhiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mnd16:222.5: Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato –
segments.mnd16:222.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito.
segments.mnd16:223.1: Puna caparaṃ bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena piṇḍapātena itarītarapiṇḍapātasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca piṇḍapātahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati, aladdhā ca piṇḍapātaṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca piṇḍapātaṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno, ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati;
segments.mnd16:223.2: tāya ca pana itarītarapiṇḍapātasantuṭṭhiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mnd16:223.3: Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato –
segments.mnd16:223.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito.
segments.mnd16:224.1: Puna caparaṃ bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena senāsanena itarītarasenāsanasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca senāsanahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati, aladdhā ca senāsanaṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca senāsanaṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno, ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati;
segments.mnd16:224.2: tāya ca pana itarītarasenāsanasantuṭṭhiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mnd16:224.3: Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato –
segments.mnd16:224.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito.
segments.mnd16:225.1: Puna caparaṃ bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena, itarītaragilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati, aladdhā ca gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno, ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati;
segments.mnd16:225.2: tāya ca pana itarītaragilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārasantuṭṭhiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mnd16:225.3: Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato –
segments.mnd16:225.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhitoti –
segments.mnd16:226.2: So tesu guttoti cīvare piṇḍapāte senāsane gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāre gutto gopito rakkhito saṃvutoti.
segments.mnd16:226.4: Atha vā āyatanesu gutto gopito rakkhito saṃvutoti.
segments.mnd16:227.1: Yatacāri gāmeti gāme yato yatto paṭiyatto gutto gopito rakkhito saṃvutoti –
segments.mnd16:228.2: Dūsito khuṃsito vambhito ghaṭṭito garahito upavadito pharusena kakkhaḷena nappaṭivajjā nappaṭibhaṇeyya, akkosantaṃ na paccakkoseyya, rosantaṃ nappaṭiroseyya, bhaṇḍantaṃ na paṭibhaṇḍeyya, na kalahaṃ kareyya, na bhaṇḍanaṃ kareyya, na viggahaṃ kareyya, na vivādaṃ kareyya, na medhagaṃ kareyya, kalahaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ viggahaṃ vivādaṃ medhagaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya, kalahabhaṇḍanaviggahavivādamedhagā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyāti –
segments.mnd16:232.3: Idhekacco bhikkhu cakkhulolo, cakkhuloliyena samannāgato hoti,“adiṭṭhaṃ dakkhitabbaṃ, diṭṭhaṃ samatikkamitabban”ti ārāmena ārāmaṃ uyyānena uyyānaṃ gāmena gāmaṃ nigamena nigamaṃ nagarena nagaraṃ raṭṭhena raṭṭhaṃ janapadena janapadaṃ dīghacārikaṃ anavaṭṭhitacārikaṃ anuyutto ca hoti rūpadassanāya.
segments.mnd16:233.1: Atha vā bhikkhu antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vīthiṃ paṭipanno asaṃvuto gacchati hatthiṃ olokento, assaṃ olokento, rathaṃ olokento, pattiṃ olokento, itthiyo olokento, purise olokento, kumārake olokento, kumārikāyo olokento, antarāpaṇaṃ olokento, gharamukhāni olokento, uddhaṃ olokento, adho olokento, disāvidisaṃ vipekkhamāno [pekkhamāno (bahūsu)] gacchati.
segments.mnd16:234.1: Atha vā bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.mnd16:234.2: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya nappaṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.mnd16:235.1: Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ visūkadassanaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.mnd16:235.2: naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ pāṇissaraṃ vetāḷaṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ sobhanakaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vaṃsaṃ dhovanaṃ hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ nibbuddhaṃ uyyodhikaṃ balaggaṃ senābyūhaṃ anīkadassanaṃ iti vā.
segments.mnd16:236.2: Idhekacco bhikkhu na cakkhulolo na cakkhuloliyena samannāgato hoti “adiṭṭhaṃ dakkhitabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ samatikkamitabban”ti na ārāmena ārāmaṃ na uyyānena uyyānaṃ na gāmena gāmaṃ na nigamena nigamaṃ na nagarena nagaraṃ na raṭṭhena raṭṭhaṃ na janapadena janapadaṃ dīghacārikaṃ anavaṭṭhitacārikaṃ ananuyutto ca hoti rūpadassanāya.
segments.mnd16:237.1: Atha vā bhikkhu antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vīthiṃ paṭipanno saṃvuto gacchati na hatthiṃ olokento … pe … na disāvidisaṃ vipekkhamāno gacchati.
segments.mnd16:238.1: Atha vā bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti … pe … cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.mnd16:239.1: Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā … pe … anīkadassanaṃ iti vā.
segments.mnd16:240.3: Idhekacco bhikkhu pādalolo pādaloliyena samannāgato hoti, ārāmena ārāmaṃ … pe … dīghacārikaṃ anavaṭṭhitacārikaṃ anuyutto hoti rūpadassanāya.
segments.mnd16:241.1: Atha vā bhikkhu antopi saṅghārāme pādalolo pādaloliyena samannāgato hoti, na atthahetu na kāraṇahetu uddhato avūpasantacitto pariveṇato pariveṇaṃ gacchati.
segments.mnd16:242.2: Pādaloliyaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya, pādaloliyā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyya, paṭisallānārāmo assa paṭisallānarato ajjhattaṃ cetosamathamanuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññāgāraṃ jhāyī jhānarato ekattamanuyutto sadatthagarukoti –
segments.mnd16:243.3: anuppannassa vā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto āyutto samāyutto,
segments.mnd16:243.6: catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto āyutto samāyuttoti.
segments.mnd16:243.8: Atha vā uppannaṃ vā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti [bahuliṃ karoti (ka.)],
segments.mnd16:244.1: Bahujāgarassāti idha bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti, rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti, rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi katvā, rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhetīti –
segments.mnd16:245.2: Upekkhāti yā catutthe jhāne upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā cittasamatā cittappassaddhatā majjhattatā cittassa.
segments.mnd16:245.3: Samāhitattoti yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi.
segments.mnd16:245.5: Catutthe jhāne upekkhaṃ ārabbha ekaggacitto avikkhittacitto avisāhaṭamānasoti –
segments.mnd16:246.3: kāmavitakko, byāpādavitakko, vihiṃsāvitakko, ñātivitakko, janapadavitakko, amaravitakko, parānudayatāpaṭisaññutto vitakko, lābhasakkārasilokapaṭisaññutto vitakko, anavaññattipaṭisaññutto vitakko –
segments.mnd16:246.5: Kāmavitakkānaṃ kāmasaññāsayo, byāpādavitakkānaṃ byāpādasaññāsayo, vihiṃsāvitakkānaṃ vihiṃsāsaññāsayo.
segments.mnd16:246.6: Atha vā takkānaṃ vitakkānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ avijjāsayo, ayoniso manasikāro āsayo, asmimāno āsayo, anottappaṃ āsayo, uddhaccaṃ āsayo.
segments.mnd16:247.1: Kukkuccanti hatthakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ pādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ hatthapādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ, akappiye kappiyasaññitā kappiye akappiyasaññitā, avajje vajjasaññitā, vajje avajjasaññitā.
segments.mnd16:247.2: Yaṃ evarūpaṃ kukkuccaṃ kukkuccāyanā kukkuccāyitattaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho –
segments.mnd16:248.1: Api ca dvīhi kāraṇehi uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho –
segments.mnd16:248.3: Kathaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho?
segments.mnd16:248.4: “Kataṃ me kāyaduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me kāyasucaritan”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.mnd16:248.7: kato me pāṇātipāto, akatā me pāṇātipātā veramaṇī”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.mnd16:248.16: katā me micchādiṭṭhi, akatā me sammādiṭṭhī”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.mnd16:248.17: Evaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.mnd16:249.1: Atha vā “sīlesumhi na paripūrakārī”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho;
segments.mnd16:249.16: “nirodho me asacchikato”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.mnd16:249.18: Takkañca takkāsayañca kukkuccañca upacchindeyya chindeyya ucchindeyya samucchindeyya pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyāti –
segments.mnd16:253.2: Cuditoti upajjhāyā vā ācariyā vā samānupajjhāyakā vā samānācariyakā vā mittā vā sandiṭṭhā vā sambhattā vā sahāyā vā codenti –
segments.mnd16:253.3: “idaṃ te, āvuso, ayuttaṃ, idaṃ te appattaṃ, idaṃ te asāruppaṃ, idaṃ te asīlaṭṭhan”ti.
segments.mnd16:253.4: Satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā taṃ codanaṃ nandeyya abhinandeyya modeyya anumodeyya iccheyya sādiyeyya patthayeyya pihayeyya abhijappeyya.
segments.mnd16:253.5: Yathā itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanajātiko sīsaṃnhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā adhimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttamaṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā nandeyya abhinandeyya modeyya anumodeyya iccheyya sādiyeyya patthayeyya pihayeyya abhijappeyya;

segments.mnd16:256.4: Sabrahmacārīsu āhatacittataṃ khilajātataṃ pabhindeyya, pañcapi cetokhile bhindeyya, tayopi cetokhile bhindeyya, rāgakhilaṃ dosakhilaṃ mohakhilaṃ bhindeyya pabhindeyya sambhindeyyāti –

segments.mnd16:260.2: Janāti khattiyā ca brāhmaṇā ca vessā ca suddā ca gahaṭṭhā ca pabbajitā ca devā ca manussā ca.

segments.mnd16:264.4: Pañca rajānīti rūparajo, saddarajo, gandharajo, rasarajo, phoṭṭhabbarajo.
segments.mnd16:265.1: “Rāgo rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati,

segments.mnd16:276.2: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa nīvaraṇehi cittaṃ muttaṃ vimuttaṃ suvimuttaṃ,
